evidence: Full CDIAL gati explicitly supplies an -(l)la extension with Hindi gayal/gail/galī path and Old Marwari gailo/galo road. The selected Bagheli geyil/geyl/geli/gelli/gəli and Kaithal gali path match this extended family; retain diphthong, schwa and gemination notation. The existing extension node is 4009-2, but the printed extension is unnumbered, so cite CDIAL 4009. These source path senses are distinguished from homonymous mortar elicitation responses.
